paite: Huan Jesu'n apai kawm in pian tung a kipan mittaw khat amu hi.
heading: Mittawsa A Piang Hihdamna
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

paite: Anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Rabbi, mittawsa a apian kua'n ahia thil hihkhial, hiai mi hia, anu leh apa?" chi in adong uhi.
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Hiai mi'n ahihkhial kei, anu leh apa'n leng ahihkhial kei uh; Pathian nasepte atung a alatna ding ahi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

paite: "Sun ahih lai in hon sawlpa nna i sep ngeingei ding uh ahi; zan hi dekdekta ahi, huai hun chiang in kuamah in nna asem thei kei ding uh.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

paite: Khovel a ka om sung in khovel vak ka hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

paite: Huchibang a agen khit in, lei ah chil asia a, tungman abawl a, huan amit ah tungman anuh hi.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

paite: Akiang ah, "Siloam dil ah va sil in,” achi a, (huai tuh Sawl chihna ahi). Va pai in asil a, mitvak in ahong kik nawn hi.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

paite: Huchi in avengte leh tuma a khutdoh a mute'n, "Hiai mi tu kawm a khutdohpa ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

paite: Midang in, "Ahi mah vo oi,” achi ua, midang in, "Hi kei e, akibatpih ahi zaw," achi uhi. Ama'n bel "Huai mi mah ka hi," achi hi.
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Na mit bangchi in ahia ahong vak?" achi uhi.
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

paite: Ama'n, "Mi khat, Jesu achih un tungman abawl a, ka mit anuh a, 'Siloam dil ah va hoh inla va sil in' ahon chi a, huchi in ka va hoh a, ka sil a, mitvakna ka muta," achi hi.
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Amah koi a om ahia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka thei kei," achi hi.
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

paite: Amaute'n Pharisaite kiang ah huai mittawpa ahon pi uhi.
heading: Pharisaite Leh Hihdam A Ompa
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

paite: Jesu'n tungman bawl a, amit ahihvak ni Sabbath ni ahi.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite'n amit ahong vak takdan adong nawn uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka mit ah tungman akoih a, ka sil a, ka mutheita hi," achi hi.
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

paite: Huan Pharisai khenkhat in, "Huai mi'n Sabbath ni atan louh ziak in, Pathian a kipan ahi kei," achi uhi. Khenkhat in bel, "Mikhial in bangchi in hichibang thillamdang ahihthei dia?" achi uhi. Huchi in akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

paite: Mittawpa kiang ah, "Na mit ahihvaksak, nang bangchibang in amah na ngaihtuah a?" achi nawn ua. Ama'n, "Zawlnei ahi,” achi hi.
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

paite: Himahleh Judate'n amit hong vakta nu leh pa asap masiah uh, mittaw ana hi him a, amit ahong vakta chih atungtang thu ataksang kei uhi.
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

paite: Anu leh apa kiang ah, "Hiai mi na tapa uh mittawsa a piang ahi na chih uh ahi hia? Bangchi in ahia tua amuh theih tak?" chi in adong uhi.
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

paite: Anu leh apa'n, "Hiai ka tapa uh ahi chih ka thei uh, mittawsa in apiang chih leng ka thei uh.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

paite: Himahleh bangchi in ahia tua hon muh theih chih ka thei kei uh, amit hihvakpa leng ka thei sam kei uh; amah dong un; piching ahi a; amah thu kigen thei ahita," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

paite: Judate akihtak ziak ua anu leh apa'n huai thute agen uh ahi; Judate'n, huai ma him in leng, amah Khrist ahi chi a gum a-omleh sinagog a pan nohsuah ding chih lem ana sa chiat ngal ua.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

paite: Huaiziak in anu leh pa'n, "Piching ahi, amah dong un," achi uhi.
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

paite: Huchi in mittawpa asam nawn ua akiang ah, "Pathian phat in hiai mi zaw mikhial ahi chih ka thei uh," achi uhi.
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Mikhial ahi hia hilou ka thei kei, thil khat ka thei, tuma in ka mit ataw a, tu in ka mutheita," chi in adawng hi.
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na tung ah bangchi in ahia ahih? Na mit bangchi in ahia ahihvak?" achi uhi.
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Den in ka hon hilhta vele, na thei nuam ngal kei ua; bang achia thei nuam nawn na hi ua? Nou leng anungzui hih sam ut na hi uh maw?" chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

paite: Huan amau amah atai ua, "Nang amah nungzui na hi, kou zaw Mosi nungzuite ka hi uh, chi in.
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

paite: Pathian in Mosi ahoupih chih ka thei uh, hiai mi koi a hong kipan ahia ka theihsak kei uh," achi uhi.
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

paite: Huai mi'n akiang uah, "Huai pentak ahi alamdanna, koi a hong kipan ahia na theih louh uh, ka mit lah ahihvak ngei ngal a," achi hi.
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

paite: "Pathian in mikhial thu angaikhe kei chih i thei uhi. Himahleh kuapeuh in Pathian alimsak a, adeihlam ahihleh, Pathian in amah angaikhia hi.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

paite: Khovel om tung a kipan kuamah mittawsa a piang mit ahihvak nawn chih akithei ngei kei hi.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

paite: Hiai mi Pathian a kipan a pawt ahihkeileh bangmah ahihthei kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Nang khial lumlet a piang in hiai bang na hon hilh vial maw?" chi in adawng uhi. Huchi in amah ahawlkhia uhi.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

paite: Huan anohkhia uh chih Jesu'n aza a; amah amuh in, "Pathian Tapa na gingta hia?" achi hi.
heading: Khalam Mittawte
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

paite: Ama'n, "Pu aw, ka gintak theihna ding in amah kua ahia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Amah na mu khinta, tua nang hon houpihpa ahi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa, ka gingta hi," chi in amah abia hi.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

paite: Jesu'n, "Thukhen ding in hiai khovel a hong ka hi, mittawte' mit ahong vakna ding uleh mitvakte' mit ahong tawtna ding un,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

paite: Akiang a Pharisai omte'n huai thu azak un, akiang ah, "Kou leng mittaw ka hi sam uh maw?" achi uhi.
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Mittaw hi le uchin khelhna nei lou ding hi uchin a, himahleh ka mu thei uh na chih ziak un khelhna ah na om gige uhi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
